role: Writes an nbt tree as Minecraft's binary NBT exactly as CompressedStreamTools.write does (tag ids, modified UTF-8 names, big-endian payloads, compound fields in JDK 8 HashMap iteration order), and hashes it to the first 8 bytes of SHA-1, the per-entity nbt hash the oracle rows carry; nbtbin_long_memo keeps each key's last scratch bytes, written bytes and block states so an unchanged entity costs a memcmp of its scratch build and a changed one a SHA-1 resumed at its first changed block.
gpu: its former globals, function statics and lazily built tables are gone (lane/gpuenv, L2): per-environment state lives in struct env (csrc/engine/env.h), per-dimension state in the replay's dims, constant tables are built before main; csrc/tests/globals.sh lists what is left
function write_compound: stack order and count arrays up to 64 fields, malloc beyond
functions write_compound and write_payload: mutual recursion over the tree depth
function write_compound: output order reproduces JDK 8 HashMap bucket order from String.hashCode (interned with the key) and insertion order
function nbtbin_long_memo: realloc of a slot's block states and scratch copy
function grow: exit(1) on allocation failure
notes: Used by entity_nbt.c's ent_digest_add (through nbtbin_long_memo keyed by entity id) to fold each entity's nbt hash into the state hash compared against the oracle's Rows.nbtLong (oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/Rows.java). The memo's value is always the SHA-1 of the root's own bytes: a build with the same scratch bytes and root is the same tree (nbtjson.h's scratch contract), and otherwise the bytes are written and compared by 64-byte block. It checks state rather than advancing it, so tick_path is false. put_utf reproduces DataOutputStream.writeUTF including the 0xC0 0x80 NUL encoding and the 65535 byte cap (it truncates rather than throwing); an all-ASCII string or key is copied directly.
